text: Very friendly, patient and helpful staff. Popped in for a check up whilst on holiday from New Zealand and I was very impressed with service and price was great especially compared to home

Our family was over due for a dental visit and we had the chance to meet Dr. Kannika from Zense Smile in Patong.

From our first interaction with this dental practice we were impressed with how organized and professional they were. I really like that we got a reminder call a day before our appointment. Once we got to Zense Smile, the team was very efficient to enter our information and get us started without any wait.

Dr. Kannika and her team were patient and gentle with each of us but especially our little one. She checked the teeth, cleaned it and only recommended a treatment if needed.

I needed a little cavity treatment and she encouraged me to try it without a numbing shot. I’m glad I listened since I was able to continue my day without the discomfort of having a partially numb mouth. I really like that she didn’t push any unnecessary treatment!

We really enjoyed our interaction with Dr. Kannika and her team. They cleaned each person’s teeth and sanitized the station, seat and had new equipment ready for the next person without any delay!

Our overall experience was fantastic with Dr.  Kannika and we would recommend Zense Smile in Patong for your dental needs while you are in Phuket, Thailand!

text: Terrible experience! I had my tooth extraction and deep cleaning on 2nd of May, 2024, unfortunately the dentist who attended me on my first visit was not on duty. Dr. Chunyanut Puwachotpitpat - gave me a traumatic experience. I had an unbearable pain, palpipated, suffered for almost 2 hours with the pain, she was saying that the tiny root of my tooth was broken and need to remove so I had to suffer for another half an hour just to finish the procedure. They asked me to come back after 5 days to remove the stitches whereas on my first visit a month ago, same procedure doesn't require for follow up because it was a job well done. Today, it's already a week since my last visit and I'm currently suffering from mouth ulcers because of that procedure that i suspect didn't do properly. I will never ever comeback to this place, I almost faint for the pain I've experienced! The worst part was, they charged me extra 1,000 THB for that suffering. Supposedly 3,500 THB since it was the same procedure from the last time, became 4,590 THB. I did complaint and they gave a discount of 500 THB, still I paid extra 500 THB for the pain they caused me! It was really a horrible experience. Nightmare, indeed!
